subject: Three science-fantasy punk characters gathered around a low table inside a gritty space station, rolling handfuls of glowing six-sided dice; one character wears a hooded techno-robe with circuit tattoos, another is a chrome-armed mercenary in a battered flight jacket, the third is an elegant alien in iridescent robes; dice clatter on the table, a wide viewport behind them shows a ringed planet and distant stars; warm amber lantern light mixing with cool holographic blue, dramatic chiaroscuro, wide-angle shot filling the frame
A confident fully-clothed heroic adventurer standing tall in a long coat, four glowing orbiting sigils around them in red, blue, green and gold representing body, gear, skill and magic

A fully-clothed traveler with one sleeve rolled back, glowing magical tattoos winding up the forearm and shoulder, one tattoo shaped like a motorcycle and another like a galloping horse, ink shimmering with arcane light
A powerful steed that is half armored warhorse and half sleek chrome motorcycle, a seamless fusion of muscle and machine, flowing mane blending into exhaust flame
